meta.name: prioritize
meta.description: Choose up to three immediate priorities from competing initiatives. Use when everything is urgent and the customer needs a defensible order with explicit deferrals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一堆都喊急的事,排出一个站得住脚的先后顺序并说清先放哪些
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头一堆事都自称紧急,需要排出谁先谁后的可交代顺序
copy.fit_line_en: For you if everything feels urgent and you need a defensible order with explicit deferrals

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会从多个互相竞争的事项里挑出最多三个当前优先项,给出能站得住脚的先后顺序,并明确写出哪些被推迟。
howto.when: 当所有事都显得紧急、需要一份站得住脚的排序和明确的推迟清单时触发;被 @fde 调用时,复用它已有的上下文与范围,不重新开始。

say.text: 这几件事都很急,帮我挑出最多三个优先做的。
say.note: 产出顺序,并明确列出被推迟的项。

say.text: 把 A、B、C 排个先后,说明哪些先放一放。
say.note: 先比较各项,再给出取舍。

say.text: 客户要一个说得过去的排期,给我最多三个优先项。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude picks up to three immediate priorities from competing initiatives, gives a defensible order, and states explicitly which items are deferred.
howto.when_en: Triggers when everything looks urgent and you need a defensible order with explicit deferrals; when called by @fde it reuses that existing sanitized context and scope.

say_en.text: Everything here is urgent—pick the top three to do first.
say_en.note: Gives an order and the deferrals.

say_en.text: Rank A, B and C, and say what to set aside.
The customer wants a defensible sequence—give me up to three.
